d: Platinum white hair is styled with messy bangs and a long, thick braid draped over the left shoulder. The eyes are a pale golden-yellow with a calm, neutral expression on a face that appears in its early twenties. This slender build is dressed in a white cropped halter top, blue trousers under brown leather chaps with metallic buckles, brown gloves, and a wide-brimmed tan cowboy hat. Signature details include a turquoise and gold choker with a central eye-shaped gem, silver arm bands, and a brown leather utility belt holding a small pouch.
